## ./filters/filters.types
BooleanFilter [type] { readonly type: 'boolean'; readonly value: boolean; }
ColumnFilter [type] BooleanFilter | DateFilter | EmptyFilter | NumberFilter | SelectFilter | TextFilter
ColumnFilters [type] Readonly<Record<string, ColumnFilter>>
ColumnFiltersParse [type] ColumnFiltersRefusal | { readonly filters: ColumnFilters; readonly kind: 'parsed'; }
ColumnFiltersRefusal [type] { readonly column: string; readonly kind: 'refused'; readonly reason: 'invalid-filter'; } | { readonly kind: 'refused'; readonly reason: 'unreadable'; }
DateFilter [type] { readonly operator: 'after' | 'before' | 'between' | 'equals'; readonly type: 'date'; /** ISO date string. */ readonly value: string; readonly value2?: string; }
EmptyFilter [type] { readonly operator: 'isEmpty' | 'isNotEmpty'; readonly type: 'empty'; }
NumberFilter [type] { readonly operator: 'between' | 'equals' | 'greaterThan' | 'greaterThanOrEqual' | 'lessThan' | 'lessThanOrEqual' | 'notEquals'; readonly type: 'number'; /** Absent from the serialised form while the value is still being typed. */ readonly value: number | undefined; readonly value2?: number; }
SelectFilter [type] { /** Defaults to `'equals'`. */ readonly operator?: 'equals' | 'notEquals'; readonly type: 'multiSelect' | 'select'; /** Single value for `'select'`. */ readonly value?: string; /** Multiple values for `'multiSelect'`. */ readonly values?: readonly string[]; }
TextFilter [type] { readonly operator: 'contains' | 'endsWith' | 'equals' | 'notContains' | 'notEquals' | 'startsWith'; readonly type: 'text'; readonly value: string; }

## ./http/http.types
PaginatedFetchArgs [type] PaginatedQuery & { /** A drill-down group token; scopes the page to that group's rows. */ readonly group?: string; /** SSR only; omit in the browser, where the origin comes from the document. */ readonly requestUrl?: string; readonly signal?: AbortSignal; readonly timeoutMs?: number; }
PaginatedQuery [type] { /** Sort-key tuple of the last row loaded, in `sorting` order, for an endpoint that can seek past it. */ readonly cursor?: readonly unknown[]; readonly filter?: ColumnFilters; readonly limit: number; /** Rows already loaded — not an offset past `cursor`, which is sent alongside it and may be ignored. */ readonly skip: number; readonly sorting?: readonly PaginatedSort[]; }
PaginatedSort [type] { readonly columnKey: PropertyKey; readonly direction?: 'asc' | 'desc'; }
